summary: Round 2. The blocking issue from review 1 is resolved. The workbench snapshots the trace when it opens and names that rerun in its header. A newer trace only enables 'Newer rerun available: replay it' and never restarts the replay, and a WorkbenchPanel Vitest covers that. The e2e test watches alignment mid-flight under the pinned header. It then compares the settled rerun second and top 3 with the Matches panel after the incident closes. The live worker makes that comparison sound: a closing incident's reruns run before its CloseTask, and backfilled reruns stream nothing. The plan covers all four tasks (the trace, the live and replay streams with both GET routes and regenerated OpenAPI types, the workbench on the Live page, Live watch and the Match explainer, and the docs). It names a concrete test for every test bullet and maps each exit-check command to its evidence, including timestamps proving the guide's screenshots came from this run's `make e2e`. It lists every README and phase document it will touch and needs no human decision. It respects the CLAUDE.md rules. The push rests on D-171 and CLOUD_HANDOFF.md, which allow it for this session. The 500-candidate deviation (D-068) is logged and stated on screen. I spot-checked the committed code: TraceRecorder, alignment(), the timing exclusions, the top-10 extra paths, the CACHE_FORMAT 2 cache, result_messages, the hub's latest trace, the contract and trace tests, and the in-progress workbench machine and store. All match the plan. Remaining items are suggestions: inconsistent thumbnail and path-size numbers in the text, a guide anchor (#live-mode) the rename will break, committing the screenshots and uncommitted files before the gate, two named but unwritten route and hub tests, and the 10 Hz React update cap.
